examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Blocked threats by country. Hover a slice, or focus the ring and use the arrow keys, to swap the center to that country.

examples.name: Types
examples.summary: A ring with the total in the center, and a solid disc with no center readout.

examples.name: Loading
examples.summary: A circular Skeleton the size of the ring.

examples.name: Empty
examples.summary: Every slice is zero, so an EmptyState holds the ring footprint. Say why the range is empty; when filters caused it, offer Clear filters.

examples.name: Markdown
examples.summary: The same data written in a docs page: `DocMarkdown` turns a `<DonutChart series={[…]} />` tag into a real `DonutChart`. The attribute values are JSON, so a docs author copies them from the props or a page entry and never imports the component.

examples.name: Page JSON
examples.summary: The same data in the marketing site's page JSON: `DonutChart` is a scene, so a band places it by name in its `scene` slot (here `console-showcase-section` with `variant: "diagram"`) and `SitePage` renders the entry with no code.
